items_flat.title_en: Anthropic: Claude Designs Protein Binders Against Scorpion Neurotoxins
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic：Claude設計對抗蠍子神經毒素的蛋白結合劑
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic announced that an internal Claude research model, operating largely autonomously over 64 hours from one initial prompt and four follow-ups developed with Citrini Research, generated 318,484 protein designs targeting five scorpion neurotoxins. Of 211 lab-tested designs (via Adaptyv Bio and Twist Bioscience), 17 met binder criteria against four toxins; all designs and data were released on Hugging Face. Anthropic stressed this is not an antivenom, as no cellular or animal neutralization tests were done.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic宣布內部Claude研究模型在與Citrini Research合作的單一初始提示與四次後續指引下，主要自主運作64小時，生成318,484個針對五種蠍子神經毒素的蛋白設計。透過Adaptyv Bio與Twist Bioscience測試211個設計後，17個符合對四種毒素的結合劑標準；所有設計與數據已在Hugging Face公開。Anthropic強調這並非抗毒血清，因未進行細胞或動物中和測試。
items_flat.analysis_en: The result shows AI agents can rapidly generate and filter credible binder candidates for neglected diseases with low commercial incentives, compressing early design from months to days. Key uncertainty remains whether these binders neutralize toxins in living systems and can be developed into affordable therapies.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 結果顯示AI代理能快速生成並篩選被忽視疾病的可信結合劑候選，將早期設計從數月壓縮至數天。關鍵不確定性仍在於這些結合劑能否在活體系統中中和毒素，並開發成可負擔的療法。
items_flat.quote: Over the next 64 hours, Claude generated over 300,000 designs; we sent 211 to Adaptyv Bio and Twist Bioscience for lab testing.
items_flat.quote_zh: 接下來64小時，Claude生成超過30萬個設計；我們將211個送交Adaptyv Bio與Twist Bioscience進行實驗室測試。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI Acquires Orchestra Bio to Expand Rosalind Life-Sciences Agents
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI收購Orchestra Bio以擴充Rosalind生科代理
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced the acquisition of Orchestra Bio, a platform where people and AI agents coordinate complex drug-development programs by monitoring studies, tracking timelines, and flagging delays. The team and technology will integrate with Rosalind (including GPT-Rosalind and Workbench) to connect scientific reasoning with operational workflows spanning internal teams and external partners.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI宣布收購Orchestra Bio，這是一個讓人員與AI代理協調複雜藥物開發計畫的平台，負責監控研究、追蹤時程並標示延遲。團隊與技術將整合進Rosalind（含GPT-Rosalind與Workbench），將科學推理與跨內部團隊及外部合作夥伴的營運工作流連結。
items_flat.analysis_en: The deal moves OpenAI deeper into operational agentic software for biopharma, pairing scientific reasoning models with workflow coordination. It signals continued expansion of domain-specific agents beyond pure research into program management.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此交易讓OpenAI更深入生物製藥的營運代理軟體，將科學推理模型與工作流協調配對。它顯示領域專屬代理正從純研究擴展至計畫管理。
items_flat.quote: We’ve acquired Orchestra Bio, a platform that helps biopharma teams coordinate the complex process of drug development.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們已收購Orchestra Bio，這是一個協助生物製藥團隊協調複雜藥物開發流程的平台。

items_flat.title_en: SpaceX Q3 Results: Super Intelligence Revenue Hits $7.6B, Over Half of Total
items_flat.title_zh: SpaceX Q3結果：超智能營收達76億美元，佔總營收過半
items_flat.summary_en: SpaceX reported unaudited Q3 2026 revenue of $14.6 billion (up 161% year-over-year) and net income of $4.4 billion. Its Super Intelligence segment (covering Grok, Cursor, Grok Bot, and neocloud compute) generated $7.56 billion, roughly 52% of total revenue and up over 800% YoY, primarily from compute rentals, the Cursor acquisition, and Grok adoption.
items_flat.summary_zh: SpaceX報告未經審計的2026年Q3營收146億美元（年增161%）、淨利44億美元。其超智能部門（涵蓋Grok、Cursor、Grok Bot與新雲端算力）產生75.6億美元，約佔總營收52%，年增逾800%，主要來自算力租賃、Cursor收購與Grok採用。
items_flat.analysis_en: The numbers confirm SpaceX’s pivot toward AI infrastructure and software as its largest revenue line, with most AI income currently from renting compute rather than Grok product sales. Heavy ongoing capex on data centers remains the central execution risk.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 數字確認SpaceX轉向以AI基礎設施與軟體為最大營收線，目前多數AI收入來自租賃算力而非Grok產品銷售。持續的資料中心資本支出仍是核心執行風險。
items_flat.quote: Delivered revenue of $14.6 billion, up 161% year-over-year, fueled by our Super Intelligence (SI) segment and accelerated growth in Connectivity.
items_flat.quote_zh: 實現營收 146 億美元，年增 161%，由我們的 Super Intelligence（SI）部門與連通性加速成長所帶動。

items_flat.title_en: Google Public Sector Launches Gemini for Government Services in Preview
items_flat.title_zh: Google公共部門推出政府服務Gemini預覽版
items_flat.summary_en: Google Public Sector announced Gemini for government services in private preview, a purpose-built agentic platform for federal, state, and local agencies. It includes specialized skills for regulatory research, FOIA redaction, procurement, and connectors to existing systems of record, with early users including HHS and the State of Missouri.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google公共部門宣布政府服務Gemini私密預覽版，這是為聯邦、州與地方機構打造的專用代理平台。它包含法規研究、FOIA塗黑、採購等專用技能，以及連接現有紀錄系統的連接器，早期使用者包括HHS與密蘇里州。
items_flat.analysis_en: The offering packages Gemini agents with government-specific skills and connectors rather than a new foundation model, aiming to reduce administrative burden while inheriting existing security and governance controls. Adoption will depend on agency trust in agentic automation for high-stakes workflows.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此產品將Gemini代理與政府專用技能及連接器打包，而非新基礎模型，目標是減輕行政負擔並繼承現有安全與治理控制。採用將取決於機構對高風險工作流中代理自動化的信任。
items_flat.quote: Today we're bringing the Gemini agent to public service with Gemini for government services in preview.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們將Gemini代理帶入公共服務，推出政府服務Gemini預覽版。

items_flat.title_en: DeepSeek Open-Sources DeepInfer, Its Production Inference Engine
items_flat.summary_en: DeepSeek open-sourced DeepInfer under Apache 2.0, the high-performance inference framework that powers its production services including DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash. It supports NVIDIA SM100 GPUs and Huawei Ascend 950 NPUs, includes optimizations such as speculative decoding, and is accompanied by deepseek-recipe for token handling; the company stated the goal is to help lower compute costs and energy use.
items_flat.summary_zh: DeepSeek以Apache 2.0開源DeepInfer，這是驅動其生產服務（含DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash）的高效能推論框架。它支援NVIDIA SM100 GPU與華為昇騰950 NPU，包含推測解碼等優化，並伴隨deepseek-recipe處理token；公司表示目標是協助降低算力成本與能源使用。
items_flat.analysis_en: Releasing a production serving stack (built primarily on vLLM) increases pressure on Western inference providers and dual-tracks Chinese and U.S. hardware. Completeness is limited: key service components such as full KV cache and load balancing are not included.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 釋出主要基於vLLM的生產服務堆疊，增加對西方推論供應商的壓力，並同時支援中國與美國硬體。完整性有限：完整KV快取與負載平衡等關鍵服務元件未包含。
items_flat.quote: We're sharing our production stack to help the community lower compute costs, reduce energy use, and make AI more affordable.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們分享生產堆疊，協助社群降低算力成本、減少能源使用，並讓AI更可負擔。

items_flat.title_en: Mistral Releases Voxtral 3 Speech Models and Voice Agent SDK
items_flat.title_zh: Mistral發布Voxtral 3語音模型與語音代理SDK
items_flat.summary_en: Mistral announced Voxtral 3, a family of state-of-the-art transcription (Mini/Small, including realtime) and speech models supporting 50+ languages, plus a LiveKit-based voice agent SDK that streams listening, reasoning with tool calls, and speaking as one pipeline. Available via Mistral’s EU/US/global API or self-deployment; transcription pricing starts at $0.0035/min and speech at $13 per million characters.
items_flat.summary_zh: Mistral宣布Voxtral 3，一套頂尖轉錄（Mini/Small含即時）與語音模型家族，支援50+語言，外加基於LiveKit的語音代理SDK，將聆聽、推理（含工具呼叫）與說話串流為單一管線。可透過Mistral歐盟/美國/全球API或自行部署；轉錄起價每分鐘0.0035美元，語音每百萬字元13美元。
items_flat.analysis_en: The release strengthens Mistral’s position in sovereign and cost-efficient voice agents, with competitive latency claims and dual cloud/self-host options. Independent verification of the multilingual SOTA claims and real-world agent reliability will determine market impact.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此發布強化Mistral在主權與高成本效益語音代理的地位，具有競爭延遲宣稱與雲端/自架雙選項。多語言SOTA宣稱與實際代理可靠性的獨立驗證將決定市場影響。
items_flat.quote: Introducing Voxtral 3: state-of-the-art Transcribe and Speech models powering Mistral’s new voice agents API.
items_flat.quote_zh: 介紹Voxtral 3：驅動Mistral新語音代理API的頂尖轉錄與語音模型。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI Rolls Out Locked Chats in ChatGPT with PIN and Biometric Access
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI在ChatGPT推出鎖定聊天，支援PIN與生物辨識存取
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI began rolling out Locked Chats, which move selected conversations out of regular history, pinned chats, and search into a protected space unlocked by a 4-digit account PIN (or Face ID/Touch ID/device unlock on mobile). New messages in locked chats remain subject to existing retention and model-improvement settings; rollout is gradual across Free, Go, Plus, and Pro users.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI開始推出鎖定聊天，將選定對話移出一般歷史、釘選聊天與搜尋，進入以4位數帳號PIN（或行動裝置Face ID/Touch ID/裝置解鎖）保護的空間。鎖定聊天中的新訊息仍受現有保留與模型改進設定約束；正逐步向Free、Go、Plus與Pro用戶推出。
items_flat.analysis_en: Locked Chats addresses shared-device and screen-sharing privacy needs but is a visibility control rather than a cryptographic safeguard; prior memory and retention policies remain unchanged. It is a modest product convenience rather than a fundamental privacy architecture shift.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 鎖定聊天解決共用裝置與螢幕分享的隱私需求，但屬於可見性控制而非加密保護；既有記憶與保留政策維持不變。這是適度的產品便利性，而非根本的隱私架構轉變。
items_flat.quote: Locked chats let you keep selected conversations in your account while hiding them from regular chat history, pinned chats, and search.
items_flat.quote_zh: 鎖定聊天讓你將選定對話保留在帳號中，同時從一般聊天歷史、釘選聊天與搜尋中隱藏。

frontier_other.summary_en: Mistral announced Voxtral 3, a family of state-of-the-art transcription (Mini/Small, including realtime) and speech models supporting 50+ languages, plus a LiveKit-based voice agent SDK that streams listening, reasoning with tool calls, and speaking as one pipeline. frontier_other.summary_zh: Mistral宣布Voxtral 3，一套頂尖轉錄（Mini/Small含即時）與語音模型家族，支援50+語言，外加基於LiveKit的語音代理SDK，將聆聽、推理（含工具呼叫）與說話串流為單一管線。可透過Mistral歐盟/美國/全球API或自行部署；轉錄起價每分鐘0.0035美元，語音每百萬字元13美元。
frontier_other.analysis_en: The release strengthens Mistral’s position in sovereign and cost-efficient voice agents, with competitive latency claims and dual cloud/self-host options. Independent verification of the multilingual SOTA claims and real-world agent reliability will determine market impact.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 此發布強化Mistral在主權與高成本效益語音代理的地位，具有競爭延遲宣稱與雲端/自架雙選項。多語言SOTA宣稱與實際代理可靠性的獨立驗證將決定市場影響。
frontier_other.quote: Introducing Voxtral 3: state-of-the-art Transcribe and Speech models powering Mistral’s new voice agents API.
frontier_other.quote_zh: 介紹Voxtral 3：驅動Mistral新語音代理API的頂尖轉錄與語音模型。

brief_en: Oct 21 AI labs: Anthropic's Claude autonomously designed scorpion-toxin protein binders; OpenAI acquired Orchestra Bio for Rosalind life-sciences agents; SpaceX Q3 showed Super Intelligence (Grok/Cursor/compute) at $7.6B (over half revenue); Google launched Gemini for Government Services preview; OpenAI rolled out Locked Chats. Open-source: DeepSeek open-sourced DeepInfer inference engine; Mistral shipped Voxtral 3 voice models/SDK.
brief_zh: 10月21日AI大廠：Anthropic Claude自主設計蠍毒蛋白結合劑；OpenAI收購Orchestra Bio擴充Rosalind生科代理；SpaceX Q3超智能（Grok/Cursor/算力）營收76億美元佔過半；Google推出政府服務Gemini預覽；OpenAI上線鎖定聊天。開源：DeepSeek開源DeepInfer推論引擎；Mistral發布Voxtral 3語音模型/SDK。
